forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.intro: Enter your account email and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account uses that email, a link is on its way. It expires in 30 minutes.
forgot.unavailable: Password reset by email isn't available right now. Please contact the administrator.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.done: Password changed — other devices were signed out
reset.missingToken: This reset link is missing its token.
